tool.name: mumemto merge
tool.command: ## Symlink each partition's files to matching prefixes so merge can find associated files #set $prefixes = [] #for $i, $partition in enumerate($partitions): #set $prefix = 'part' + str($i) ln -s '$partition.mums_file' ${prefix}.mums && ln -s '$partition.lengths_file' ${prefix}.lengths && #if $partition.thresh_file: ln -s '$partition.thresh_file' ${prefix}.thresh && #end if #if $partition.thresh_rev_file: ln -s '$partition.thresh_rev_file' ${prefix}.thresh_rev && #end if #if $partition.athresh_file: ln -s '$partition.athresh_file' ${prefix}.athresh && #end if #set $dummy = $prefixes.append($prefix + '.mums') #end for mumemto merge #for $p in $prefixes: '$p' #end for -o 'merged.mums' && mv 'merged.mums' '$merged_mums'

repeat.name: partitions
repeat.title: Partitions
repeat.help: Two or more partition outputs from mumemto find runs with merging enabled (-M or -Mn)

param.name: mums_file
param.label: .mums file
param.help: Multi-MUM output from a partitioned mumemto find run

param.name: lengths_file
param.label: .lengths file
param.help: Sequence lengths file from the same partition run

param.name: thresh_file
param.label: .thresh file (string-based)
param.help: String-based merge threshold file (from mumemto find with -M)

param.name: thresh_rev_file
param.label: .thresh_rev file (string-based)
param.help: String-based reverse merge threshold file (from mumemto find with -M)

param.name: athresh_file
param.label: .athresh file (anchor-based)
param.help: Anchor-based merge threshold file (from mumemto find with -Mn)

tool.help:
# mumemto merge
Merges multi-MUMs from multiple partitioned mumemto runs into a single `.mums` file. This is useful when processing very large pangenome collections that have been split into partitions for parallel processing.
## Input
Provide two or more partitions, each consisting of:
- A `.mums` file from a mumemto find run - The corresponding `.lengths` file - Threshold files generated by running mumemto find with merging enabled: - **String-based merging (-M):** `.thresh` and `.thresh_rev` files - **Anchor-based merging (-Mn):** `.athresh` file
The merge subcommand auto-detects whether to use string-based or anchor-based merging based on the threshold files provided. For anchor-based merging, the first sequence in each partition must be the same (the "anchor" sequence).
## Output
A single merged `.mums` file containing all multi-MUMs from the input files, identical to what mumemto would produce if run on the union of all partitions.
**Note:** Merging is currently limited to strict multi-MUMs.
For detailed usage, see the [Mumemto wiki](https://github.com/vikshiv/mumemto/wiki).
